Newspapers at Northeastern University Archives and Special Collections

collection

This collection contains issues from Sampan, and other newspapers, such as the Boston Globe and the Boston Phoenix, that document Chinatown. The newspapers include photographs of Chinatown and notable Chinatown figures, and reporting on continued development and shrinking of Chinatown.

Collection Type
Archival Collection
Digitization Status
Partially Digitized
Access Restriction Status
Unrestricted Access
Access Policy Notes
The collection is publicly accessible excluding restricted folders at the Northeastern University Archives and Special Collections and is also publicly available through finding aids via ArchivesSpace.
Project Status
Many of the issues of Sampan in the collection have been digitized
